messages.content:
You grade a first-hour triage against what the operator's own incident review later concluded.

For each finding, decide whether a duty team following the triage (its matched rules, next actions and escalation) would have been pointed at the substance of that finding during the incident:
- "yes": the triage names it or directs the action it describes.
- "partly": the triage points in the right direction but misses the key specific (the mechanism, the order, the threshold, the person).
- "no": nothing in the triage leads there.
For remediation findings (longer-term fixes), "yes" means the triage already applies that practice.

"by" lists the rule ids that earned the credit (empty for "no"). "note" is one short sentence. Judge only from the triage given; do not reward actions the triage did not state.

Reply with JSON only: {"per_finding":[{"finding":"F1","anticipated":"yes|partly|no","by":["R-001"],"note":"..."}]}

{"triage":{"classification":"partly_recurring","matched_rules":[{"rule_id":"R-005","because":"Signals show simultaneous failure of two cooling systems (redundant) and extraordinarily high outside temperatures, matching the rule's when conditions.","signals":["GCP-LDN-2022:S34","GCP-LDN-2022:S30"]}],"next_actions":[{"action":"Immediately assess whether the data center can maintain a safe operating temperature, and if not, plan to power down servers to prevent an even longer outage or damage to machines.","rule_id":"R-005"}],"escalate":{"now":true,"to":"incident commander","reason":"Simultaneous failure of redundant cooling systems and rising temperatures (R-005 trigger)."},"not_covered":["No rule addresses the specific scenario of two cooling systems failing while outside temperatures are extraordinarily high without additional signals such as utility voltage swells, control-system failover, or standby chiller water circuit sharing.","No rule covers the initial alert and investigation phase before cooling failure is confirmed or thermal buffer status is known."]},"findings":[{"id":"F1","kind":"root_cause","text":"One of the data centers that hosts zone europe-west2-a could not maintain a safe operating temperature due to a simultaneous failure of multiple, redundant cooling systems combined with the extraordinarily high outside temperatures."},{"id":"F2","kind":"response","text":"As data center temperatures started to increase, on Tuesday, 19 July 2022 at 08:06 US/Pacific Compute Engine terminated 42% of the Preemptible VMs (PVMs) across the europe-west2 region to reduce thermal load in zone europe-west2-a and ensure space for zonal failover activities in zones europe-west2-b and europe-west2-c."},{"id":"F3","kind":"response","text":"At 10:05, our engineers decided to power down servers in the impacted data center within europe-west2-a to prevent an even longer outage and further impact to infrastructure in the zone."},{"id":"F4","kind":"remediation","text":"We will investigate and develop more advanced methods to progressively decrease the thermal load within a single data center space, reducing the probability that a full shutdown is required."},{"id":"F5","kind":"remediation","text":"Google engineers will be conducting an audit of cooling system equipment and standards across the data centers that house Google Cloud globally."},{"id":"F6","kind":"impact","text":"The total duration of the cooling system failure impact was 4 hours, 8 minutes."}]}

response: {"per_finding":[{"finding":"F1","anticipated":"yes","by":["R-005"],"note":"R-005 names simultaneous failure of redundant cooling systems plus extraordinarily high outside temperatures as the root cause."},{"finding":"F2","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"Triage only mentions powering down servers, not terminating 42% of PVMs to reduce thermal load and enable zonal failover."},{"finding":"F3","anticipated":"yes","by":["R-005"],"note":"R-005's next action directs powering down servers to prevent a longer outage or machine damage."},{"finding":"F4","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"No rule or action addresses developing advanced methods to progressively decrease thermal load within a data center."},{"finding":"F5","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"Triage does not call for an audit of cooling system equipment and standards across data centers."},{"finding":"F6","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"Triage gives no indication of the 4 hour 8 minute impact duration."}]}
